sections.heading: Order Processing
paragraphs: Orders are processed by our trusted fulfillment checkout partner. Typical production time is 2-7 business days before shipment.

sections.heading: Shipping
paragraphs: Delivery timelines vary by destination. Tracking details are sent after dispatch so you can monitor your order in transit.

regions.label: United States
regions.text: Production: 2-7 business days · Delivery: 3-8 business days.

regions.label: Europe
regions.text: Production: 2-7 business days · Delivery: 5-12 business days.

regions.label: International
regions.text: Production: 2-7 business days · Delivery: 7-18 business days.

sections.heading: Returns & Replacements
paragraphs: If your item arrives damaged or incorrect, contact support within 7 days of delivery with clear photos and order details for a replacement review.
Standard return SLA: resolution response within 2 business days and replacement decision within 5 business days.

sections.heading: Contact
paragraphs: For shipping and order issues, contact us at Mamaafricaafia@gmail.com.
